subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this focused doctor credential-preservation fix land now, or wait for broader shipped-shape coverage or coordination with adjacent auth-migration PRs?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes upgrade-time handling of sensitive auth credential material, which is an owner-level compatibility and security-boundary choice rather than an automation-only repair.

options.title: Land after auth owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused fix with its existing before/after proof and tests, then coordinate adjacent auth-migration PRs independently.

options.title: Add shipped-shape coverage first

options.title: Hold for adjacent migration work
options.body: Pause only if maintainers decide this fix should be bundled with the runtime import or legacy-flat merge PRs.

recommendation.title: Land after auth owner pass
